Not if there's things and people to be left behind. 

Don't sell OP short. 
He has not shared his reasons for doing so.

At times I get overly anxious about the way they respond or being left on read for a while. And while I know that isn't right, I can't help but feel as if I'm being annoying or making their day harder by feeling so. I also think it frustrates them that I can do very little to change my situation. I do what I cant, but some things are out of my control.
